slides.title: You're counting. Out loud.
slides.body: Round one, round two. Clean reps, clear head. This time you've got it.

slides.title: Then the burpees happen.
slides.body: Somewhere between rep 12 and the floor, the number quietly leaves your body.

slides.title: You check the chalk marks.
slides.body: There are five. Some are rounds. One is where you put your hand down.

slides.title: You ask your partner.
slides.body: "Four, I think." They're on their own round six. They don't know either.

slides.title: Coach asks for your score.
slides.body: "Four plus... a lot." Coach writes down 4 and keeps walking.

slides.title: New system: a pile of coins.
slides.body: Move one per round. By round three, you're also counting the coins.
